يتنازعون (form VI)
# يَتَنَازَعُونَ (yatanāzaʕūna) /ja.ta.naː.za.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# يُتَنَازَعُونَ (yutanāzaʕūna) /ju.ta.naː.za.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
